notes.title: Update 0.23.7 is here – Major Performance Boost
notes.notes:
Hello Commander,

Today we’ve released version 0.23.7 – bringing some key improvements:

✅ Bugfix: A bug that sneaked in during the Indie Game Fest has been fixed. The AI was occasionally confused – this should now be resolved.
✅ Performance boost: We implemented a major performance update. On some systems, we’re seeing up to double the FPS!
✅ Improved camera: The camera now moves much more fluidly across the battlefield – no more stutters or jerky movements.

We’re still hard at work on the upcoming graphics update. The feedback at the Indie Game Fest was amazing – thank you! We estimate it’ll take one or two more months until it’s ready.

Thanks for playing – see you in the next update!
Your Section Gamma Team

notes.title: Patch 0.23.3
notes.notes:
Hello, Commander,

We’ve released a small update for [b]Section Gamma[/b] addressing a few bugs:

✅ [b]AI bug fixed:[/b] In certain situations, AI units inside bunkers were firing on themselves.  
✅ [b]Window positions saved:[/b] Moved windows will now stay in place and no longer reset.  
✅ [b]Event management issue fixed:[/b] Rare errors in the AI’s event system caused illogical moves — this has been corrected.

Thanks for your feedback — and see you on the battlefield, Commander!

notes.title: Mac Version in Beta Branch & Patch 0.23.2
notes.notes:
Hello, Commander,

We've released a new update for [b]Section Gamma[/b], bringing exciting new features and important fixes!

✅ [b]Mac version now available in the Beta branch:[/b]  
You can now play Section Gamma on macOS!  
To access it, go to your Steam Library, open the game’s [i]Properties[/i], select the [i]“Betas”[/i] tab, and opt into the beta branch. Steam will then download the latest Mac-compatible version.  
Note: Older Intel Macs are not supported. If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out!

✅ [b]Fix for unit upgrade timing:[/b]  
A timing bug caused unit upgrades to not appear immediately – this has been fixed. We've also improved the descriptions of upgraded units.

✅ [b]Improved AI behavior:[/b]  
AI players now actively consider [b]defense towers[/b] if they are still able to attack – not just during existing conflicts.

✅ [b]Additional tweaks:[/b]  
Some icons have been refined, and various smaller bugs have been fixed.

The update is now live – thank you for your feedback and continued support!

[b]See you on the battlefield, Commander![/b]  
Your [i]Section Gamma[/i] Team

notes.title: Update is here – Tutorial fixed & Mission 2 for everyone!
notes.notes:
Hello, Commander,  

We've just released an update for [b]Section Gamma[/b]! The biggest issue was a bug that made the tutorial unplayable. Huge thanks to everyone who reported this – your feedback helped us track it down and fix it quickly!  

As a token of appreciation, we have [b]unlocked Mission 2 for all players – for free![/b]  

Here are the key fixes in this update:  

✅ Fixed an issue in the internal event system that [b]prevented single-player missions from starting properly[/b].  
✅ Fixed the [b]tutorial bug[/b] that made it unplayable.  
✅ Various [b]text and translation fixes[/b].  
✅ Adjusted text size on some buttons that didn’t fit properly.  
✅ Fixed an issue where [b]buying large amounts of actions[/b] could cause an error message.  
✅ [b]Mission 3:[/b] A wrong story sequence triggered when repairing the headquarters.  

The update is now live on Steam – thanks again for your support and valuable feedback!  

[b]See you on the battlefield, Commander![/b]  
Your [i]Section Gamma[/i] Team

[b]Hello Commander,[/b]

The day has come – [b]Section Gamma[/b] officially launches into [b]Early Access today[/b]!

After intense development and invaluable community feedback, we’re excited to present the first major step in our [b]turn-based strategy game[/b]. From now on, you can dive into thrilling battles, refine your tactics, and take control of the battlefield.

[b]What to expect at the Early Access launch:[/b]

🤖 [b]Improved AI[/b] – Since the demo, we’ve worked hard to make the AI smarter and more challenging. Get ready for tough opponents that will test your strategies!

🐞 [b]Bug fixes and optimizations[/b] – Thanks to community feedback, we’ve fixed numerous issues and improved the overall gameplay experience.

⚔ [b]Multiplayer action for everyone[/b] – The [b]base game remains free[/b], so you can jump straight into tactical multiplayer battles – whether against human opponents or the AI.

[b]Your support matters![/b]  
We’re eager to hear your feedback, as your input helps us shape and improve [b]Section Gamma[/b]. If you enjoy the game, we’d greatly appreciate a [b]positive review on Steam[/b] – it helps us tremendously and ensures that more players discover the game.

notes.title: Prepare for Early Access – The Demo Will Be Disabled
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44116730/9afee6fec154a8b5c42f99b4ff5ba24d21aa43f1.jpg[/img]

Hello Commander,

The launch of Section Gamma Early Access is getting closer! To prepare for the transition, the demo will be disabled on February 23rd. But don’t worry – your save data will carry over, so you can pick up right where you left off when Early Access begins on March 14th.

At launch, you can expect four fully playable campaign missions, and our voice actors have already completed a significant portion of their work. If all goes well, we might even have a fifth mission ready at launch – if not, it will follow shortly after.

The Android version is also on the way and will be released shortly after Early Access begins.

We’re beyond excited to finally bring Section Gamma to Early Access! Thank you for your support – and get ready for battle!

See you soon, Commander!

notes.title: Development Updates
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44116730/100bcbcfc47278e486ed8726acf6fe5ab11ebbb5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dear future Commanders,[/h3]

We are pleased to announce that Section Gamma is entering its final development phase! Our AI for skirmish matches has made significant progress and now offers challenging matches that will test your tactical skills. Look forward to cooperative battles with friends against or alongside AI opponents.

The storyline of our single-player campaign is finalized, and we are currently working to present you with at least the first 3 missions at the start of Early Access.

Our internal beta testing now covers a wide range of platforms, including Windows, Mac, Steam Deck, as well as smartphones and tablets running Android. We are diligently working on an iOS version. Our goal is to ensure compatibility across all platforms upon release.

We want to express our gratitude for your patience and understanding as we work on the final details of our game. Although we are working on an Early Access title, we are taking the time to ensure that Section Gamma provides the best possible gaming experience.

We have learned ourselves that the last 20 percent before release takes the most time. On one hand, we must meet all requirements from Steam, Google, and Apple. On the other hand, continuous testing uncovers bugs that need fixing, and we implement improvements necessary for smooth gameplay.

Nevertheless, we are confident that we will soon be able to provide an exact release date, but we must remain realistic: a release in the second quarter of 2024 is unfortunately unlikely.

We will keep you updated and look forward to welcoming you soon to the world of Section Gamma!

Your Section Gamma Development Team

notes.title: Section Gamma will be delayed
notes.notes:
Quick update for you all. We're moving the Early Access release of Section Gamma to Q2 2024. We're a small team of two and we want to make sure the single player AI is top notch before launch.
We know it's a bit of a wait, but we're doing our best to give you a great game. Your support means everything to us, and we're super excited to bring you something special.
Thanks for your patience and understanding. Stay tuned for more updates!
